value.rationale: Egalitarian total rank and minimum regret are standard competing fairness objectives. The sharp distinction between first disagreement and first incompatibility identifies the smallest market where aggregate welfare and worst-case protection cannot be simultaneously optimized, and the exact four-agent quotient explains the entire preceding layer.
